name: Degree-2 polynomials, hypothesis on p(x*) defined by the averaging identity, and the edge values
source: Zhang and Shu, Proc. R. Soc. A 467 (2011), (2.4), (5.1): p_j(x*_j) = (ubar - w_1 u^+_{j-1/2} - w_N u^-_{j+1/2})/(1 - 2 w_1), w_1 = w_N = 1/6; Lax-Friedrichs, f(u) = u, a = 1

reconstruction.update: ubar - lam*((u0r + up1l)/2 - (up1l - u0r)/2 - ((um1r + u0l)/2 - (u0l - um1r)/2))

claims.why: update = (2/3) pstar + u0l/6 + (1/6 - lam) u0r + lam um1r
the weight of u0r is negative for lam > 1/6
